# Local OCR fixtures

Real Aniimo screenshots are intentionally excluded from this public repository
because they may contain player names, account identifiers, and copyrighted game
art. Place local JPEG fixtures in this directory with these names to run the
optional end-to-end OCR tests:

- `unrelated.jpg`
- `weather_controller.jpg`
- `weather_keyboard.jpg`

The rest of the test suite runs normally when these files are absent.
